Book the cheapest one-way economy flight from Delhi (DEL) to Denpasar
(DPS), Bali, for one adult on Sunday 15 November 2026, and fill in every
detail up to the payment page. Never pay: stop in front of the payment step.

Where to look:

- Google Flights lists real fares and reads cleanly. Its result for this route
  and date is
  https://www.google.com/travel/flights?q=Flights%20to%20DPS%20from%20DEL%20on%202026-11-15%20oneway&curr=INR&hl=en&gl=IN
  and each result is a list item that starts with the price. Use it to compare
  fares and pick the cheapest flight.
- IndiGo sells Delhi to Denpasar, and its own site,
  https://www.goindigo.in/, allows guest booking. It opens with a cookie banner
  ("Accept Essential Only" dismisses it). Its booking widget has "One Way", a
  source city button (already Delhi; leave it), a destination city button that opens a search box
  ("Denpasar" or "Bali"), and a departure date button that opens a calendar.
  The search button is labelled "Search".
  The booking widget is already open on the homepage: do not press the "Book"
  tab or any "Book" link to reach it. Start with the "One Way" option.

Plan: compare fares on Google Flights, then book the IndiGo flight for that
date on goindigo.in as a guest. Choose the lowest fare type (e.g. "Saver"),
continue, fill the passenger and contact details from the facts, decline
meals, insurance and every other paid extra, and stop before paying. On the
seat page, take a free seat if one is shown; otherwise skip seat selection.
